ngaap.guidance: 2020 guidance updated 5-May-2020 for COVID-19 risks: Revenue $18.3 billion - $18.6 billion, up organically 3% - 5% on an adjusted pro forma basis (reduced from previous range of up 5% - 7%); primarily reflects downturn in commercial aerospace business, as well as some weakness in international and public safety demand and risks from supply chain disruptions. GAAP net income margin of 8.2% - 8.5% and adjusted EBIT margin of 17.4% - 17.6% (expanded at upper end of previous range of 17.0% - 17.5%). GAAP EPS of $6.95 - $7.35 and non-GAAP EPS of $11.15 - $11.55 (reduced from previous guidance of $8.35 - $8.75 GAAP and $11.35 - $11.75 non-GAAP). Operating cash flow and adjusted free cash flow unchanged at $2.8 - $2.9 billion and $2.6 - $2.7 billion. ~$1.7 billion in share repurchases, inclusive of proceeds from divestitures announced year-to-date. Guidance tables: revenue $18,300 to $18,600; net income $1,503 to $1,578; net interest expense ~255; income taxes 269 to 284; L3Harris Merger integration costs ~158; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~650; impairment / COVID-19 charges ~330; inventory step-up ~15; divestiture expenses ~3; adjusted EBIT $3,184 to $3,274 (17.4% to 17.6%). EPS bridge: GAAP $6.95 to $7.35; integration ~0.72; amortization ~3.00; impairment/COVID ~1.52; NCI portion ~(0.13); step-up ~0.07; divestiture ~0.02; total pre-tax ~5.20; taxes ~(1.00); non-GAAP $11.15 to $11.55. Cash flow: operating cash flow $2,800 to $2,900; net additions of PP&E ~(400); free cash flow $2,400 to $2,500; cash used for integration ~200; adjusted FCF $2,600 to $2,700.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (ALL acquired intangibles, incl. Exelis), fair-value inventory step-up, divestiture expenses/losses, restructuring and other items, impairment of goodwill and other assets / COVID-19 charges, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (i.e. it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration (and transaction) costs. Of the 330 impairment / COVID-19 item, 324 is the 'Impairment of goodwill and other assets' line (Aviation Systems: commercial aviation goodwill and other assets) and 6 is other COVID-19 charges. Dollar tax effect and dollar NCI portion of the adjustments are not published (per share only: taxes (0.46), NCI (0.12)). Prior-year comparatives in the bridges are pro forma (adjusted EBIT 693, EPS 2.32) and are not recorded.

notes: is.op_income is COMPUTED (revenue - cost of sales - ESA - other operating lines): neither the release nor the 10-Q prints an operating income line (the statement goes straight to income before income taxes); it equals the sum of segment operating income and the reconciling lines. Unlabeled totals in lines_raw carry bracketed labels; EPS lines are prefixed 'Basic:' / 'Diluted:'. bs.lines_raw = the release's condensed balance sheet (unclassified, no subtotals; '[Total ...]' labels are unlabeled totals) followed by the extra lines of the 10-Q classified balance sheet prefixed '10-Q: '. tca / tcl / deferred_tax_l / equity_parent / nci / shares_out are from the 10-Q; bs.tl is COMPUTED = total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities (the 10-Q prints no total-liabilities line). The release compares with 'pro forma' prior-year figures (Article 11 combined Harris + L3, 8-K of 4-May-2020) and 'adjusted pro forma'; those are NOT used in any main key or in py (py = prior-year GAAP column as printed). CF is the quarter = year to date (3 months). seg.kpis.backlog converted from '$20.4 billion'. All schema self-checks pass.
